runtime_help: Pico ADC/DSP suite: commands are lowercase, one per line.
preset 0..8: BASIC, IQ-AM, IF-AM, IF-AMSYNC, IF-FM, IF-FSK, USB, LSB, IF-CW
mode basic|am|amsync|fm|usb|lsb|cw; input iq|i|q; tune -12000..12000 Hz
volume 0..100; squelch -1=off or 0..12; hang 0..7; swap 0|1; iqcorr 0|1
page 0..4 (4=timing); stream 0|1; status; help. Reboot resets settings and DSP history.
BASIC ignores receiver controls except gain/volume. IF forces swap/iqcorr off.
measure start|stop: all-block timing window; cumulative diagnostics never reset.

analysis.physical_measurement_provenance: User-reported GP26 DC 1.635 V; ADC counts are separate automated readings, not calibrated scope volts. Fresh GP27 FM min/max not supplied.

analysis.remaining_stage_cost: Receiver DSP dominates ordinary work; FFT filtering is its largest measured substage. Separate spectrum preparation adds roughly 730 us on update blocks. Stage maxima are independent and must not be summed; no claim of exact causal attribution per overrun.
analysis.identity_limit: Runtime source fingerprint matched published artifact, not independent binary readback.
analysis.demodulation_verdict: Not measured: no 500 Hz recovered-frequency/amplitude or deviation-response evidence yet.
